name: Chicken and Zucchini Gruyere Casserole
evidence: No chicken zucchini cheese bake in catalog; nearest chicken neighbors chicken-divan-broccoli-bake (broccoli + divan cream, different veg/flavor) and slow-cooker-creamy-chicken-mushroom-bowls (served-over bowl, no zucchini/gruyere gratin) are distinct dishes, and accepted-slugs chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake (cauliflower + ranch/bacon) differs in veg and flavor family.
cross_protein_collisions: Structurally a creamy cheese-bound low-carb protein+non-starchy-veg bake (Gruyere/mushroom/zucchini). A turkey version (turkey breast or ground turkey zucchini gruyere bake) would be the SAME dish - decider should check other-protein pools for a turkey/pork zucchini-cheese bake twin.

Adjacent but distinct: chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake (already accepted) shares the low-carb creamy chicken-veg-bake format but differs in vegetable (cauliflower vs zucchini) and flavor (ranch/bacon vs gruyere/mushroom).
notes: Cuisine American - does not widen the catalog's American skew, but clears all run conditions and is a genuine low-carb dish not present in catalog or accepted list.
